summary: Most consumer discretionary businesses succeed or fail based on the broader economy. This sensitive demand profile can cause the industry to underperform when macro uncertainty enters the fray, and over the past six months, its 4.1% return has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 8.3% gain.
content:
Most consumer discretionary businesses succeed or fail based on the broader economy. This sensitive demand profile can cause the industry to underperform when macro uncertainty enters the fray, and over the past six months, its 4.1% return has fallen short of the S&P 500's 8.3% gain.

Investors should tread carefully as many companies in this space are also unpredictable because they lack recurring revenue business models. Taking that into account, here are three consumer stocks best left ignored.

Occasionally featuring celebrity hosts like Ryan Seacrest on its shows, iHeartMedia (NASDAQ:IHRT) is a leading multimedia company renowned for its extensive network of radio stations, digital platforms, and live events across the globe.

Annual revenue growth of 6.5% over the last five years was below our standards for the consumer discretionary sector

Diminishing returns on capital from an already low starting point show that neither management's prior nor current bets are going as planned

8× net-debt-to-EBITDA ratio makes lenders less willing to extend additional capital, potentially necessitating dilutive equity offerings

At $3.59 per share, iHeartMedia trades at 7.7x forward EV-to-EBITDA. Read our free research report to see why you should think twice about including IHRT in your portfolio, it's free .

Established in 1993, Monarch (NASDAQ:MCRI) operates luxury casinos and resorts, offering high-end gaming, dining, and hospitality experiences.

Muted 14.1% annual revenue growth over the last five years shows its demand lagged behind its consumer discretionary peers

Free cash flow margin is forecasted to grow by 1.5 percentage points in the coming year, potentially giving the company more chips to play with

Rising returns on capital show management is making relatively better investments

Monarch is trading at $122.75 per share, or 18.6x forward P/E. Check out our free in-depth research report to learn more about why MCRI doesn't pass our bar .

With a massive network spanning 155 distribution centers and delivering over 250,000 different food products, Performance Food Group (NYSE:PFGC) distributes food and food-related products to over 300,000 restaurants, convenience stores, theaters, and institutions across North America.

Products are seeing elevated demand as its unit sales averaged 6.6% growth over the past two years

Ability to fund investments or reward shareholders with increased buybacks or dividends is restricted by its weak free cash flow margin of 1.2% for the last two years

Performance Food Group's stock price of $114.39 implies a valuation ratio of 21.7x forward P/E. To fully understand why you should be careful with PFGC, check out our full research report (it's free) .

chineseSummary: 大多数非必需消费品企业的成功或失败取决于更广泛的经济。当宏观不确定性加剧时，这种敏感的需求状况可能会导致该行业表现不佳，在过去六个月中，其 4.1% 的回报率低于标准普尔 500 指数 8.3% 的涨幅。
chineseContent:
大多数非必需消费品企业的成功或失败取决于更广泛的经济。当宏观不确定性加剧时，这种敏感的需求状况可能会导致该行业表现不佳，在过去六个月中，其 4.1% 的回报率低于标准普尔 500 指数 8.3% 的涨幅。

投资者应该谨慎行事，因为这个领域的许多公司也因为缺乏经常性收入商业模式而难以预测。考虑到这一点，以下是最好忽略的三只消费类股票。

iHeartMedia（纳斯达克股票代码：IHRT）是一家领先的多媒体公司，以其遍布全球的广泛广播电台、数字平台和现场活动网络而闻名，偶尔会有 Ryan Seacrest 等名人主持其节目。

过去五年 6.5% 的年收入增长率低于我们非必需消费品行业的标准

资本回报率从本来就很低的起点开始递减，这表明管理层之前和当前的押注都没有按计划进行

8 倍的净债务与 EBITDA 比率使得贷方不太愿意提供额外资本，可能需要稀释股权发行

iHeartMedia 的股价为每股 3.59 美元，其远期 EV 与 EBITDA 之比为 7.7 倍。请阅读我们的免费研究报告，了解为什么您应该三思而后行，将 IHRT 纳入您的投资组合中，它是免费的。

Monarch（纳斯达克股票代码：MCRI）成立于 1993 年，经营豪华赌场和度假村，提供高端游戏、餐饮和酒店体验。

过去五年年收入增长 14.1%，表明其需求落后于非必需消费品同行

预计来年自由现金流利润率将增长1.5个百分点，这可能会给公司带来更多筹码

资本回报率的上升表明管理层正在做出相对更好的投资

Monarch 的交易价格为每股 122.75 美元，即预期市盈率 18.6 倍。查看我们的免费深入研究报告，详细了解 MCRI 未通过我们标准的原因。

Performance Food Group (NYSE:PFGC) 拥有覆盖 155 个配送中心的庞大网络，提供超过 250,000 种不同的食品，向北美各地超过 300,000 家餐厅、便利店、剧院和机构分销食品和食品相关产品。

产品需求量增加，过去两年单位销量平均增长 6.6%

由于过去两年自由现金流利润率仅为 1.2%，该公司通过增加回购或股息来为投资提供资金或奖励股东的能力受到限制

Performance Food Group 的股价为 114.39 美元，意味着估值率为 21.7 倍的远期市盈率。要充分了解为什么您应该小心 PFGC，请查看我们的完整研究报告（免费）。
